messages:
Anya Li: quick run of a11y checks on the new filter toolbar + insights panel. Two things: screen reader announces the filter group as "Group" and the filter popover traps focus when you open checkboxes. Also legend colors on small charts fail 3:1 on some backgrounds.
Kevin Patel: can you paste the VO readout? i want to repro.
Anya Li: yes — VoiceOver reads: "Group, group" then the chips, no aria-label. Steps: tab to Filters → press space to open popover → VO says "Group" twice. Happens on Safari/VO and NVDA.
Marta G: that sounds like missing aria-label on the container. If the dom uses <div role="group"> we should add aria-label="Filters" or use <fieldset><legend>.
Sam O'Neill: +1 for fieldset/legend for semantics. simpler for keyboard too.
a11y-bot: axe run on /insights returned: 1 low-contrast (chart-legend), 1 duplicate-accessible-name (filter group), 1 keyboard trap (filter popover). Full report: /reports/1754503210-axe.json
Anya Li: proposed quick fixes:
- change group markup to <fieldset><legend class="sr-only">Filters</legend> and remove role="group"
- add focusable close button in popover header and ensure tab loop allows escape
- adjust chart palette: swap #6B6BFF -> #5A4BCC (meets 4.5:1 on white) and #FFD580 -> #C69D00 for small swatches
Kevin Patel: for keyboard trap can we do focus management like: on open, focus first checkbox; on close, return focus to filter trigger. Also handle Escape to close.
Marta G: snippet for focus management:
```
popover.on('open', () => firstCheckbox.focus());
popover.on('close', () => filterButton.focus());
keydownHandler(e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') popover.close(); }
```
Sam O'Neill: regarding aria-live for toasts — current toasts use role="status" and aria-live="polite" which is ok, but when we batch 3 toasts quickly VO collapses them. Suggest aria-atomic and ensure we only announce summary: "3 uploads completed" instead of three separate toasts.
Anya Li: good point. i'll update toast behaviour in next PR and include e2e test for keyboard flow. Can someone pick up the fieldset/legend change? @Marta
Marta G: I'll take the markup change and color tokens update. Will send PR today.
Kevin Patel: I'll add focus return + Escape handling and a test in puppeteer.
Anya Li: thanks! i'll follow up with screenshots and a quick demo snippet. :thumbsup:
